description: This file manages WiFi services, including creating, starting, stopping, deleting, and handling events for different WiFi service types. It interacts with service descriptors, manages service lifecycle, and references external modules like wifi_hal and wifi_ctrl.

methods.name: char * get_service_name_from_type(wifi_service_type_t type,wifi_service_name_t name)
methods.description: Returns the string name corresponding to a given service type, and copies the name into the provided buffer.

methods.name: wifi_service_t * get_service_by_type(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_type_t type)
methods.description: Retrieves the first service matching the specified type from the services manager.

methods.name: void services_mgr_delete_service(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_name_t name)
methods.description: Removes a service from the manager by name and frees associated resources.

methods.name: void services_mgr_delete_service_by_type(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_type_t type)
methods.description: Deletes a service based on its type.

methods.name: wifi_service_t * create_service(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,rdk_wifi_radio_t * radio_config,wifi_hal_capability_t * hal_cap,const service_t * service)
methods.description: Creates a new WiFi service based on its name, initializes its descriptor, and sets up nodes.

methods.name: int services_mgr_start_service(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_name_t name)
methods.description: Starts a specific service by name.

methods.name: int services_mgr_start_service_by_type(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_type_t type)
methods.description: Starts a service based on its type.

methods.name: int services_mgr_stop_service(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_name_t name)
methods.description: Stops a specific service by name.

methods.name: int services_mgr_stop_service_by_type(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_service_type_t type)
methods.description: Stops a service based on its type.

methods.name: int services_mgr_event(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Dispatches an event to all managed services.

methods.name: void services_mgr_deinit(wifi_services_mgr_t * mgr)
methods.description: Deinitializes the services manager, currently empty.

methods.name: int services_mgr_init(wifi_ctrl_t * ctrl,rdk_wifi_radio_t * radio_config,wifi_hal_capability_t * hal_cap,const service_t * service,unsigned int num_svcs)
methods.description: Initializes the services manager with provided configuration, setting up all services.

ctags.name: services_mgr_init
ctags.signature: (wifi_ctrl_t * ctrl,rdk_wifi_radio_t * radio_config,wifi_hal_capability_t * hal_cap,const service_t * service,unsigned int num_svcs)
